questions.question_text:
Communication barrier is anything that ________ communication.
(A) impedes
(B) enhances
(C) aids
(D) visualizes
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: A barrier is an obstacle that impedes or hinders the successful transfer of a message.

questions.question_text:
Strict rules are ________ barrier in communication.
(A) personal
(B) political
(C) organizational
(D) language
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Strict hierarchies and rules within a company are classified as organizational barriers to communication.

questions.question_text:
It is the process of decoding symbols and saying aloud.
(A) Listening
(B) Speaking
(C) Writing
(D) Reading
questions.answer:
(D)
Explanation: Reading involves decoding written symbols (text) and interpreting or voicing them.

questions.question_text:
Grapevine communication is an ________ way of communication.
(A) official
(B) unofficial
(C) written
(D) nonverbal
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The grapevine refers to the informal, unofficial flow of information in an organization.

questions.question_text:
The response of the sender message is called ________.
(A) feedback
(B) decoding
(C) encoding
(D) forming an opinion
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Feedback is the receiver's response or reaction sent back to the original sender.

questions.question_text:
Haptics is a ________ communication.
(A) technical
(B) verbal
(C) nonverbal
(D) written
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Haptics is the study of communicating through touch, which is a form of nonverbal communication.

questions.question_text:
She is one of the girls who ________ won a number of medals.
(A) has
(B) have
(C) are
(D) is
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: "Who" refers to the plural "girls," so the plural verb "have" must be used.

questions.question_text:
________ is a device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy.
(A) Battery
(B) Aerodynamics
(C) Dynamo
(D) Solar panel
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: A battery chemically stores energy and converts it to electrical energy upon discharge.
questions.chapter: Unit 2 - English: The Language of Science & Technology

questions.question_text:
Instructions which encourage live participation and interaction through online classes are called ________
(A) Synchronous communication
(B) Asynchronous communication
(C) Traditional instructions
(D) theoretical instructions
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Live, real-time participation in online classes represents synchronous communication.

questions.question_text:
The meaning of netiquette is ________.
(A) network education terminology
(B) necessary teaching etiquette
(C) internet etiquette
(D) classroom manners
questions.answer:
(C)
Explanation: Netiquette is a portmanteau for "internet etiquette."

questions.question_text:
Which one of the followings is irrelevant to synchronous communication?
(A) video call
(B) e-mail
(C) in-person meeting
(D) phone calls
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: E-mails are typically read and answered at a later time, making them asynchronous.

questions.question_text:
Choose the correct parallel structure: Priya likes ________
(A) running, walking, and being active
(B) running, walking and outdoor activities
(C) running, walking, and be active
(D) runs, walking, and be active
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Parallel structure requires all listed verbs to take the gerund (-ing) form.

questions.question_text:
Searching for a specific piece of information is ________
(A) skimming
(B) scanning
(C) for complete comprehension
(D) critical reading
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: Scanning involves sweeping over text rapidly to locate specific data or keywords.

questions.question_text:
Neither of the answers ________ correct.
(A) is
(B) are
(C) were
(D) being
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: "Neither" is grammatically singular and takes the singular verb "is."

questions.question_text:
It is used to highlight a product, company or service.
(A) Brochure
(B) Book
(C) Magazine
(D) Notice
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: A brochure is an informative paper document used specifically for marketing or advertising products/services.

questions.question_text:
Feasibility report is a result of ________
(A) survey to find out the possibilities of something
(B) controlling problems, sell products and services
(C) monitoring and control production, sales, shipping, etc
(D) solving problems
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: A feasibility report evaluates the practicality and chances of success of a proposed plan.

questions.question_text:
Fill in the gap with suitable connectives.
Our teacher thinks that Rahul is poor in his studies. ________, it is he who secured the highest marks in the class.
(A) However
(B) Because
(C) Hence
(D) Therefore
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: "However" is used to introduce a statement that contrasts with the previous clause.

questions.question_text:
She ________ an assignment since this morning.
(A) had been writing
(B) has been witting
(C) have been writing
(D) has writing
questions.answer:
(A)
Explanation: Using "had been writing" indicates an action continuing over a period. (Note: 'has been writing' would be ideal, but A is the only grammatically valid choice provided due to the typo in B).

questions.question_text:
Project proposal is a ________
(A) specially designed report
(B) document showing a plan of action
(C) report written for specific purpose
(D) document getting for fund
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: A project proposal proposes a specific plan of action to address a problem or opportunity.

questions.question_text:
It is the official list of items to be discussed in a particular meeting.
(A) Notice
(B) Agenda
(C) Proposal
(D) Circular
questions.answer:
(B)
Explanation: The agenda lists all the activities and discussion points planned for a meeting.
